evidence: With local codebase/src and a clean venv overlaying huggingface_hub==1.2.2, AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained('facebook/opt-125m', torch_dtype=torch.float16, use_safetensors=True) completed successfully. The loaded tensors were on cpu, not meta: lm_head.weight.is_meta=false and model.decoder.embed_tokens.weight.is_meta=false, and the two weights shared storage.
steps: Created a venv with system site packages and installed the hub dependency needed for the local transformers checkout to import cleanly.
Ran the exact OPT-125m safetensors load path from the bug report against codebase/src.
Inspected lm_head.weight and model.decoder.embed_tokens.weight after loading; both were materialized on cpu and shared storage.
